thread:
Emma - Sales: quick sync — AtlasBridge trial-run starts next week. they sent back the security questionnaire and want a short POC for SSO + SCIM + RBAC. need owners for tech answers and a rough cost pro-forma for a 2-week dedicated pool during the trial. can someone take the technical lead?

Raj - Solutions: I can own tech answers. main asks from atlas: domain proofing (they want delegated claim + DNS TXT approach), SCIM delta throughput (they plan bulk imports and frequent deltas), and an RBAC mapping example for their 3 roles (admin, auditor, end-user). also they asked about SAML metadata rotation window.

Sam - Security: tagging in. for questionnaire items I need to confirm: our SAML SP supports metadata signing and can accept idp-initiated. also need to confirm audit log retention for private/dedicated customers. atlas asked about SOC2 section — i'll paste the relevant line items in a sec.

Nina - SalesOps: on pricing — they want an estimate for a 2-week Dedicated slot (4x A100 equiv) and a fallback hosted plan if latency spikes. do we pro-rate Dedicated weekly or bill month minimum?

Raj - Solutions: sales ops: we usually pro-rate on a daily basis for short trials, but need finance sign-off for multi-GPU commitments. i'll draft the technical appendix for the questionnaire.

Raj - Solutions: quick config snippet for SCIM recommendations we should send (they asked for safe defaults):
```
scim: 
  delta_rate_limit_per_minute: 300  # recommended for POC (can reduce in prod)
  bulk_import_window: 1200        # seconds to allow large imports
  retry_backoff: exponential(2s, max=5m)
```

Emma - Sales: perfect. can we also give a short RBAC mapping sample so their IAM team can see the shape?

Raj - Solutions: yep — sample mapping below (send as JSON in questionnaire response):
```
roles: 
  - name: admin
    permissions: ["model.deploy","billing.read","users.manage"]
  - name: auditor
    permissions: ["audit.read","logs.view"]
  - name: end_user
    permissions: ["generate","embeddings.read"]
```

Sam - Security: for domain proofing we support both DNS TXT and email-based validation, but atlas asked for delegated claims (we can support issuer binding via DNS TXT). also confirm SCIM over TLS with client certs if they require mTLS. i need the questionnaire QIDs for SOC2/ISO items — paste them here and i'll fill.

Emma - Sales: i'll attach the questionnaire PDF from their security team in the ticket. ops-bot: can you provision a short-lived dedicated trial SKU estimate (2 weeks, 4 GPUs) so we can include numbers in the response?

ops-bot: provisioning estimate created: EST-AB-179555 — 2-week dedicated (4x A100 equiv) estimated list = $28,000, recommended trial discount = 25% -> $21,000 pro-rated. contact finance@redwood.com to change pricing.

Nina - SalesOps: noted. i'll confirm with finance and add line items for ingress/egress and support (onsite review if requested).

Raj - Solutions: one more note for the questionnaire: include this SAML metadata rotation recommendation for them to plan key rollover: 
```
rotation: 
  rotation_window_days: 7  # overlap for old/new keys
  recommended_lookahead: 3 # days to start testing new keys before cutover
```

Sam - Security: i'll answer the SOC2 and audit log retention Qs and confirm KMS/HSM support for Private deploys. i'll need a copy of their legal addendum to check redaction/flow.

Emma - Sales: thanks team. action items: Raj — prepare the technical appendix + sample JSON answers; Sam — fill security questionnaire sections; Nina — confirm finance/pro-rate and final estimate; Emma — consolidate and send reply to AtlasBridge security contact by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Raj - Solutions: will do.

Sam - Security: on it.

Nina - SalesOps: looping finance now.

ops-bot: ticket AB-179555 created, checklist items assigned to Raj, Sam, Nina.
